  "text": "For three days, the blank card stayed blank. Imani checked it each afternoon, pretending she had come in for a roll. On Thursday, a little boy wrote toast in large, uneven letters. Beneath it, someone else added: Stir a spoonful into plain yogurt.

Her grandfather handed him the last jam pocket. ‘Better make it a big one.’"
